mentions.name: Mossy
mentions.description: This Mac app displays a little plant in the corner of the screen that wilts when the user doesn't take breaks, encouraging regular rest during computer work.
mentions.problem: People forget to take breaks while working at their Mac.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a little plant that sits in the corner of my Mac and wilts when I don't take breaks. https://heymossy.com
